author: More Perfect Union
description:
BREAKING: The House just voted 216-212 to pass a national defense authorization act that takes a huge step towards meshing the U.S. and Israeli militaries.

This legislation would massively expand U.S.-Israel defense technology cooperation and integration.

One portion of the bill, the United States-Israel Defense Technology Cooperation Initiative, would give Israel access to U.S. military and intelligence systems’ technology, information, and supply chain, while giving the U.S. very little in return.
title: BREAKING: The House just voted to integrate Israel and the US Military

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Millions of Americans could now see their student debt payments triple. Borrowers could pay an average of $4,000 more per year.

Trump is axing the $342 billion SAVE program that kept costs down for borrowers in crippling debt, while demanding $350 billion for the Pentagon.

Now borrowers face predatory private collectors, wage garnishment, and withheld tax refunds.

This isn’t about savings. It’s about corporate profits.
title: Student debt payments are suddenly tripled now?
